assets.generation_summary: One low swell, silent until 39.6s, rising under the closing line and never resolving - the sound is still rising at the cut, like the picture.
Narration with the closing swell mixed under it at 0.5.

THE MARKS. Warm paper with a faint grain. A coastal section drawn in ink at the bottom third: a wedge of shore, the sea as a flat sea-blue field, and two horizontal tide marks ruled across it with light construction lines that are never cleaned up. The water rises to the upper mark, falls, and rises again - twice, in the time it takes to say the line. Nothing else is on the page.
Assets-gate review still.

THE PLATE. The view leaves the shore and becomes the whole figure: a circular Earth drawn in ink at the centre of the page, the Moon small at the right margin, a light dashed axis between them. The near-side water swells toward the Moon in sea blue - obvious, expected. Then the far side swells too, drawn just as plainly, and the figure simply sits there being impossible.
Assets-gate review still.

THE ANNOTATION. A curved vermilion arrow is drawn onto the plate sweeping outward from the far side - exactly the annotation a textbook margin would add - with a handwritten-looking label beside it. It is drawn respectfully, at full weight. Then one vermilion stroke crosses the whole annotation out. The struck-through mark stays on the page: this is a correction, not an erasure.
Assets-gate review still.

THREE PULLS. The plate is cleared back to the bare body and axis. Three vermilion arrows are drawn along the Moon's axis - at the near ocean, at the centre of the Earth, at the far ocean - each one drawn as its clause is spoken, each visibly shorter than the last. Nothing is labelled. The lengths are the argument.
Assets-gate review still.

STACKED. The three arrows lift off the body and stack at the margin against a common baseline, like a figure inset, so the difference in their lengths is unmistakable at a glance. The body stays faintly behind them. Thin leader lines connect each stacked arrow back to where it came from.
Assets-gate review still.

THE SUBTRACTION. The middle arrow - the pull on the Earth itself - is taken away from all three. The near arrow keeps a short remainder pointing toward the Moon; the centre arrow vanishes to nothing; the far arrow's remainder points the other way, away from the Moon. Two outward remainders at opposite ends of the planet, arrived at by arithmetic rather than assertion. The blue swells return undern
Assets-gate review still.

THE BATH. A bathtub drawn in the same ink on the same paper, sitting where the planet was, at the same scale on the page. The same three vermilion arrows are drawn on it - and this time all three are exactly the same length. The water does not move. It goes on not moving for slightly longer than is comfortable.
Assets-gate review still.

THE CAPTION. The closing line set in the plate's serif, low on the page, positioned and weighted like the caption under a figure rather than like a title. Above it the page is mostly empty, with the ghost of the body still faintly present.
Assets-gate review still.

STILL LEAVING. The caption stays. The small Moon at the right margin goes on drifting outward, slowly, and is still drifting when the video ends - it never reaches the edge and it never stops. The last frame is in motion, which is the exact opposite of how the previous production closed.
Assets-gate review still.
